evidence.claim: eBay says it collects personal data when you use its Services, create an account, submit forms or add or update account information.
eBay lists data about interactions with its advertising partners, including ads shown and actions taken such as clicks, among the data it processes.

For users outside the EEA, Switzerland and the UK, eBay lists advertising and content personalization, measurement and analytics, on and off its sites, as a purpose (within those regions it relies on consent).
eBay says it deletes or anonymizes personal data under its retention and deletion policy unless legally obliged or permitted to keep it longer.
Cookie settings can be managed in your browser or device settings.

eBay processes data about your activity and interactions with its advertising partners and lists advertising, personalization and analytics as purposes; it says data is deleted or anonymized under its retention policy.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 6.274.0.1 (report dated Sept. 22, 2026) found code signatures for 7 known tracker SDK(s): AppsFlyer (analytics), Facebook Analytics (analytics), Facebook Login (identification), Facebook Share, Google CrashLytics (crash reporting), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), OpenTelemetry (OpenCensus, OpenTracing) (analytics). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
